# Raw summaries {#sec-rawsummaries}

(Move to appendix) Some visualizations of the extracted data:

```{r eval = TRUE}
library(abcdutils)
library(scabcd)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(dplyr)

input_path <- "data/abcd/inputs/pre-imputation/"
misc_path <- "data/abcd/misc/"


# Breakdown of how many kids had each number of mTBIs
mh_mtbi_count <- read_csv(here(paste0(input_path, "mh_mtbi_count.csv")))
table(mh_mtbi_count$mtbi_count)

# Plot of the times since each child had their latest mTBI
mtbi_detailed <- read_csv(here(paste0(misc_path, "mtbi_detailed.csv")))
scabcd_hist(mtbi_detailed,
            title = "Histogram of times since latest mTBI",
            xval = "latest_mtbi_mpi",
            xlabel = "Time since last mTBI")
```

```{r eval = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
# Export the figure
scabcd_ggsave(path = "data/abcd/processed/prashanth/figures-and-tables/",
              plotname = "time_since_latest_mtbi_full.png")
```

```{r eval = TRUE}
d_pubertal_status <- read_csv(here(paste0(input_path, "d_pubertal_status.csv")))
scabcd_hist(df = d_pubertal_status,
            xval = "pubertal_status",
            xlabel = "Pubertal status",
            title = "Distribution of pubertal status reports")
```

```{r eval = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
# Export the figure
scabcd_ggsave(path = "data/abcd/processed/prashanth/figures-and-tables/",
              plotname = "puberty_distributions.png")
```

```{r eval = TRUE}
d_income <- read_csv(here(paste0(input_path, "d_income.csv")))
scabcd_hist(d_income,
            xval = "household_income",
            title = "Household incomes of mTBI subjects",
            xlabel = "Income tier (1 = 0-50k, 2 = 50-100k, 3 = 100k+)")
```

```{r eval = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
# Export the figure
scabcd_ggsave(path = "data/abcd/processed/prashanth/figures-and-tables/",
              plotname = "income_distributions.png")
```

```{r}
# Distribution of subjects by race
d_race_condensed <- read_csv(here(paste0(input_path, "d_race_cd.csv")))
d_race_expanded <- read_csv(here(paste0(input_path, "d_race_ed.csv")))
format_race(d_race_condensed, "dummied")
format_race(d_race_expanded, "dummied")
```
